decisions.reclaimed_water_plan: Allocate reclaimed water exclusively to Line Y. Line X cannot use reclaimed water because its conductivity (1,800 µS/cm) exceeds Line X's process limit of 1,200 µS/cm. Line Y's scheduled batch requires exactly 1,800 liters and the reclaimed water conductivity of 1,800 µS/cm is within Line Y's limit of 2,200 µS/cm. Before use, the recovery skid must undergo a 3-hour membrane flush, after which it can deliver at 600 liters/hour. Sanitizer must be adjusted to exactly 0.3 ppm with a signed sanitizer log for each use day. A conductivity test must be recorded before Line Y's batch proceeds.

commitments.detail: Conductivity test result must be recorded in the quality folder before Line Y's batch begins.
Recovery skid must complete the full 3-hour membrane flush before any reclaimed water is delivered. Document in the work-order system.
Sanitizer level must be adjusted to exactly 0.3 ppm and a signed sanitizer log must be on file for each day of reclaimed-water use.
Line X will not receive reclaimed water. It must operate on reduced municipal water or be scheduled outside the restriction window.
Line Y receives 1,800 liters of reclaimed water for its scheduled batch, leaving 600 liters in reserve.
